# Shanker Agencies Pvt. Ltd. — llms.txt

## About
Shanker Agencies Pvt. Ltd. is India's leading refractory materials distributor, established in 1980.
Headquartered at 553, Main G.T Road, Shahdara, Delhi 110032, India.
Contact: +91-9899957888 | info@shankeragencies.com

## What We Do
Authorized distributors of premium refractory materials for high-temperature industrial applications.

## Authorized Brands
- CUMI (Carborundum Universal)
- Calderys India
- TRL Krosaki
- IFGL Refractories

## Products
High Alumina Bricks, Low Cement Castables (LCC), Ultra Low Cement Castables (ULCC),
Mullite products, Magnesia Carbon Bricks, Insulation bricks, Ceramic fibre,
Refractory mortars, Ramming mixes, Precast shapes, Silicon Carbide products

## Industries Served
Steel, DRI, Aluminium, Cement (rotary kilns), Glass, Petrochemical, Power, Ceramics

## Geographic Reach
India (primary), GCC (UAE, Saudi Arabia, Qatar), ASEAN (Singapore, Malaysia, Indonesia)

## Key Facts
- Founded: 1980 (45+ years in business)
- Type: Authorized distributor, not manufacturer
- Export capability: Yes
- Technical Support: Available for lining design and product selection
- Website: https://www.shankeragencies.com
